hotel_name: The Langham Huntington, Pasadena, Los Angeles

claims.text: The hotel is in Pasadena at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.

findings.quote: Nestled at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, our hotel is located in beautiful Pasadena — a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.

claims.text: The covered Picture Bridge has been a feature of the hotel since 1932.

findings.quote: America’s only covered Picture Bridge has been a charming feature of the hotel since 1932.

claims.text: The hotel is set on 17 acres of greenery.

findings.quote: Enjoy The Langham Huntington's 17 acres of lush greenery

claims.text: The Langham Club is on the 8th floor and overlooks the Horseshoe Garden, with views of San Marino and the valley beyond.

findings.quote: The Langham Club, located on the 8th floor and overlooking the Horseshoe Garden

claims.text: Guests of Club Executive Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.

findings.quote: Guests of Club Executive Rooms and Suites enjoy complimentary access to The Langham Club

claims.text: Lanai Rooms have large French doors opening onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the historic Lanai Pool.

findings.quote: large French doors which open onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the historic Lanai Pool

claims.text: President Gerald Ford was a frequent guest of Ford Cottage.

findings.quote: President Gerald Ford was a frequent guest of this charming cottage

claims.text: Eastview Cottage was built in 1920 as a second home for Mrs. McNally of Rand McNally atlases.

findings.quote: Built in 1920, Eastview Cottage originally served as a second home to Mrs. McNally of Rand McNally atlases.

claims.text: Wisteria Cottage was built in 1929 and has a cone-shaped ceiling and French doors that lead to a patio.

findings.quote: Built in 1929, our most private and romantic cottage features a unique cone-shaped ceiling, gorgeous living spaces, and French doors that lead to an enchanting patio.

claims.text: The hotel's spa has treatments based on traditional Chinese medicine.

findings.quote: The 11,000-square-foot spa was renovated in 2010 and has treatments based on traditional Chinese medicine.

claims.text: The Picture Bridge displays 41 replica oil paintings of California landscapes.

findings.quote: Admire the 41 replica oil paintings set in this dynamic museum.

claims.text: The hotel has been the setting for films and television shows including Westworld, Saving Mr. Banks, The Parent Trap and Modern Family.

findings.quote: has been the setting to hundreds of films and television shows — including Westworld, Saving Mr. Banks, The Parent Trap, Modern Family, and more.

claims.text: The hotel's classic architecture and landscape were designed by the same key figures as the nearby Huntington Library.

findings.quote: with classic architecture and landscape designed by the same key figures as the nearby Huntington Library

claims.text: The Tournament of Roses Suite is a two-story penthouse with views of the Horseshoe Garden, San Marino and the San Gabriel Mountains.

findings.quote: Our showstopping two-story penthouse commands 360-degree views of the Horseshoe Garden, San Marino, and the majestic San Gabriel Mountains.

claims.text: The hotel offers a quarterly interactive guided film tour through My Valley Pass.

findings.quote: Explore our film history with a quarterly interactive guided tour through My Valley Pass.

claims.text: The hotel is in Pasadena, a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles, not in the city center.

findings.quote: our hotel is located in beautiful Pasadena — a short drive from Downtown Los Angeles.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
